newsitem.title: USA: Swiss Army alleges trademark infringement.
newsitem.headline: Swiss Army alleges trademark infringement.

text.p: Swiss Army Brands Inc said Wednesday it had filed suit against Price/Costco Inc in the U.S. District Court for the Eastern District of New York, alleging trademark infringement and unfair competition.
The suit, filed Monday, alleges that Price/Costco has falsely represented, on the Internet and within the Eastern District of New York, that Swiss Army is a vendor company of Price/Costco.

Swiss Army said the suit also alleges that Price/Costco's use of Swiss Army's trademarked name misleads consumers into believing the retail chain had an authorized association with goods that bear the Swiss Army name.
Swiss Army seeks to prevent Price/Costco from using its name in any manner that implies Swiss Army Brands is a direct source of product supply to Price/Costco stores.
Swiss Army said it also wants the court to stop the retailer from using the term "Swiss Army" in connection with watches made or distributed without its authorization.
Price/Cosco, based in Issaquah, Wash., was not available for comment on the suit.
